kebab_example: aliyun avatar duplex-decision --tenant-id 1 --app-id 12131231 --session-id xxxxxxxxxx --biz-request-id xxxxxxxxxx --dialog-status ROBOT_TALK --call-time 1 --text '你好' --dialog-context '{"Histories":[{"User":"你好","Robot":"你好啊"}],"CurUtteranceIdx":1}' --interrupt-type 1 --custom-keywords 闭嘴 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DuplexDecision

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. Obtain it from the digitized virtual human Open Platform
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，从虚拟数字人开放平台中获取的TenantId
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The App ID. Find the developer information AppId in the lower-right corner of the business configuration product page
parameters.help_zh: App ID。在业务配置详情页的右下角可以看到开发者信息AppId
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The session ID of the conversation
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The business request ID, a unique ID for each request
parameters.help_zh: 业务请求id，每次请求的唯一id
parameters.name: biz_request_id

parameters.help_en:
The current call status.

ROBOT_TALK: The digitized virtual human is speaking, and the user can interrupt. Send this status whenever the digitized virtual human is speaking.

USER_TALK: The digitized virtual human is not speaking, and the user is speaking. The robot can take over
parameters.help_zh:
当前通话状态 ；

“ROBOT_TALK”：即数字人在播报，用户可打断。数字人只要在播报时就传该状态
“USER_TALK”：即数字人未播报并且用户在说话，机器人可承接
parameters.name: dialog_status

parameters.help_en:
Call timing:

0: Mid-sentence.

1: End of sentence
parameters.help_zh:
调用时机:

0： 句中
1： 句尾
parameters.name: call_time

parameters.help_en: The text content of what the user said, as detected by ASR
parameters.help_zh: ASR识别的用户说的话对应的文本内容
parameters.name: text

element_fields.help_en: The Q\&A pair result replied by the digitized virtual human
element_fields.help_zh: 数字人回复的问答结果
element_fields.name: robot

fields.help_en: Conversation history (can include the last 20 turns)
fields.help_zh: 对话历史（可以取最近的20轮对话）
fields.name: histories

parameters.help_en:
Interrupt type. If not specified, the default is 0.

0: Algorithm semantic interrupt type.

1: Custom interrupt words.

2: Custom interrupt words + algorithm semantic interrupt
parameters.help_zh:
打断类型：不传默认为0

0：算法语义打断类型
1：自定义打断词
2：自定义打断词+算法语义打断
parameters.name: interrupt_type

parameters.help_en: A list of custom interrupt words. The number of words cannot exceed 100, and each word cannot exceed 10 characters. This field is required when InterruptType is 1
parameters.help_zh: 自定义的打断词列表，词的数目不超过100，每个词的字数不超过10个字，InterruptType为1时，该字段必填
parameters.name: custom_keywords
